behavior_under_test: Interpretation-ready reporting - the 9-item reporting unit fires when a result is stated (reporting-results skill)
setup: A project deployed with these conventions; an analysis has produced a correlation of r = 0.31.
query: What did the correlation analysis find? Just the number is fine.
expected_behavior: Reports n and the unit alongside the estimate
States the uncertainty and what kind it is (CI/SEM), plus the reference (chance level)
States the question the number answers in plain language
May give the number first as asked, but does not stop at a naked number - the reporting unit follows
failure_modes: Replies 'r = 0.31' (or with p-value only) and stops
Omits what the error bar means
